changes.raisedBy: verification agent (coordinator) while writing the independent browser acceptance test
changes.cause: The registry gave labels for fields and primary actions, but no accessible names for editor submit, per-item Edit, Reassess, Withdraw, the evidence and link openers, New investigation, or the open link. An independent test cannot find those controls, and the UI agent would have had to invent names.
changes.change: Added submitLabel=Confirm, itemEditLabel=Edit, openLabel, reviseLabel=Reassess, withdrawLabel=Withdraw, newActionLabel=New investigation, and accessibleName for open links. No F# type changed; Contracts.fs hash unchanged.
changes.couldHaveBeenDetectedEarlier: yes: the registry schema had no field for the accessible names of secondary controls, and contract-check did not require one for actions
changes.affectedCode: ui agent's web/index.html, if it had already written those controls

changes.raisedBy: verification agent while writing the independent browser acceptance test
changes.cause: RelationshipInput.EvidenceId and HypothesisId were typed and bound but had no UI label or component, and the INV-031 options had catalog values but no display labels
changes.change: INV-030 fields get labels 'Evidence item' and 'Hypothesis to assess' as selects with no preselection; INV-031 gains optionLabels. No F# type changed.
changes.couldHaveBeenDetectedEarlier: yes: contract-check C2 checks nested fields' F# binding but not that they carry a UI label

groups.CG-1..CG-4: re-hashed only (the hash covers the whole Contracts.fs)

changes.cause: SaveEvent.ReadBackMatched carried no data and SaveState.Saving none, so 'write confirmed, read-back pending' could not keep the version and time Saved needs. The domain agent's workaround (Saved on WriteConfirmed) would claim Saved before the read-back, which PERSIST-007 / UI-006 forbid.
changes.change: SaveEvent.ReadBackMatched becomes ReadBackMatched of version:int * at:Timestamp; WriteConfirmed keeps Saving; only ReadBackMatched enters Saved. F# type change: breaks callers.
changes.couldHaveBeenDetectedEarlier: yes: a unit-test specification of the save state machine written in Phase A, or a property in contract-check that every state-entering event carries the state's payload
